settings.title: Desktop applications
settings.description: Device passwords: one per device and mailbox, revocable on its own (MailForge, phones, other mail clients).
settings.enabledHint: Desktop applications sign in with the Mint account and receive one device password per mailbox. Off: only the address and password of a mailbox (or a manual app password) work.
settings.idleDays: Revoke a device not seen for (days)
settings.idleDaysHint: MailForge checks in once a day: an active computer never loses its access.
settings.revokedAllowance: Do not ban an address for failures right after a revocation
settings.revokedAllowanceHint: For 72 h after device passwords of a mailbox were revoked or expired, as many failures of that mailbox are not counted towards a ban (an office whose devices were all disconnected stays reachable).
